quizName: Hardest Questions in Nevada Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT need to be checked regularly?
questions.explanation: Check your tires, controls, chain, sprockets, shock absorbers, fasteners, and brakes before every ride. Small mechanical problems on a motorcycle are very dangerous.

questions.question: How can a motorcycle operator help others see them?
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors, use your headlight all the time, and use your turn signals to help others see you.

questions.question: What is a benefit of wearing a leather jacket while riding?

options.text: Can make a rider look cool.
Is usually too warm to wear when riding.
Should not be worn when riding.

questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved leather jacket for protection. In warm weather, many motorcycle jackets are designed to keep you cool while protecting you.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel tired while riding?

options.text: Keep going and hope to wake up.
Get off the road and rest.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get off the road and rest.
questions.explanation: Do not ride if you are tired. Take rest breaks at least every two hours on long trips to avoid getting fatigued.

questions.question: What should a motorcycle rider constantly watch for on the road?
questions.explanation: Watch the road ahead for changing traffic, hazardous conditions, and escape routes. Be ready to react to any changes.

questions.question: What kind of soles should motorcycle riding shoes have?
questions.explanation: Choose boots or shoes that are high and sturdy with hard, durable, slip-resistant soles to support your ankles.

questions.question: How can you reduce head and neck injuries?
questions.explanation: Wearing a high-quality helmet greatly reduces head and neck injuries. A helmet is your best defense in an accident.

questions.question: Why are turn signals important on a motorcycle?

options.text: Serve little purpose since motorcycles are smaller than most other vehicles.
Are very important to alert other motorists to a rider's intentions.
Should not be used if no vehicles are close to the motorcycle.
Are more complicated than those on a car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are very important to alert other motorists to a rider's intentions.
questions.explanation: As a motorcycle rider, you are vulnerable. Always use turn signals to alert others to your plans. Use them any time you turn or change lanes, even if no one is nearby.

questions.question: How should a helmet fit for best protection?
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets DOT and state standards. It should fit snugly all the way around with no obvious damage.

questions.question: What type of footwear is best for a motorcycle operator?
questions.explanation: Wear sturdy boots or high-top shoes that support your ankles. If your boots have long laces, tuck them in securely before riding.

questions.question: Mirror checks should:

options.text: Be part of your normal routine while riding.
Be avoided because they distract you.
Be avoided because other drivers can see you.
Only be done in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be part of your normal routine while riding.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often to know what is behind you. Mirror checks should be a regular part of how you scan the road.

questions.question: A motorcycle fits you if:

options.text: You can touch your feet to the ground while seated.
You can reach the controls by stretching.
The handlebars go over your head.
Your feet cannot rest on the foot pegs.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can touch your feet to the ground while seated.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle fits you properly when you can touch the ground with your feet while sitting on it. You should also be able to easily reach and operate all controls.

questions.question: When checking tire pressure:

options.text: Looking at the tire is a good method.
Squeeze the tire with your hand.
Compare the tire height to another tire.

questions.explanation: Use a tire gauge to check pressure before each ride. A tire can look normal even when it is not properly inflated.

questions.question: To improve visibility, a motorcycle operator should:
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors with reflective materials so other drivers can see you. Also use your headlight at all times and use your signals and brake light properly.

questions.question: Your body can only get rid of alcohol through:
questions.explanation: Only time allows your body to remove alcohol. There is no fast way to sober up.

questions.question: Which surface gives a motorcycle the best traction?
questions.explanation: Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lane markings, and metal plates are all more dangerous for motorcycles than dry pavement.

questions.question: Keeping space between your motorcycle and other vehicles:

options.text: Gives you time to react if another driver makes a mistake.
Limits your movement to one area of the lane.
Lets you depend on others to find hazards.
Requires you to ride faster to keep up with traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gives you time to react if another driver makes a mistake.
questions.explanation: Keep space around your motorcycle on all sides. This gives you time and room to react if another driver makes a mistake.

questions.question: Which fabric protects a motorcyclist the most?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants offer the best protection for riders.

questions.question: If you cannot avoid a slippery surface, you should:

options.text: Speed up and lean the motorcycle.
Speed up and keep the motorcycle upright.
Slow down and lean the motorcycle.
Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright.
questions.explanation: Keep your motorcycle upright and go slowly across slippery surfaces.

questions.question: Most motorcycles have which types of brakes?
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have one brake for each wheel. The front brake does most of the braking work.

questions.question: What type of boots or shoes provide the best protection when riding?

options.text: Boots with long laces that hang loose.
Boots that cover the ankle and provide support.

questions.correctAnswerText: Boots that cover the ankle and provide support.
questions.explanation: Choose boots or heavy shoes that cover and support your ankles. Use low heels so they won't catch on things. Tuck in long laces so they don't get caught in the motorcycle's moving parts.

questions.question: Where should you find the best information about your motorcycle?

options.text: Someone who owns a different type of motorcycle.
A television show about motorcycle riding.

questions.explanation: Read your motorcycle's owner's manual before riding it for the first time. This is especially important if you are riding a borrowed motorcycle. The manual has information specific to your motorcycle.

questions.question: Which item is not protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Safe riders wear a helmet, eye protection, a jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves. Sandals do not provide protection.

questions.question: Which item does not protect a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, high boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles, and gloves made of durable material. A baseball cap does not provide protection.

questions.question: What material are motorcycle riding gloves usually made from?
questions.explanation: Motorcycle riding gloves are usually made of leather. They improve your grip and protect your hands and fingers.
